# Outright Landscape Construction — Company and Service Reference

## Company identity

Outright Landscape Construction is a landscape contractor based in Covina, California. The business was founded in 2020 and lists California contractor license CSLB #1073845, classification C-27 Landscaping Contractor.

- Website: https://outrightlandscape.com/
- Phone: (626) 343-6028
- Email: office@outrightlandscape.com
- Location: Covina, CA 91722

Customers should confirm the current license status directly with the California Contractors State License Board. Bond, insurance, workmanship, and manufacturer-warranty terms should be requested and reviewed for the specific project.

## Services

The company offers project-specific estimates for:

- Landscape installation, renovation, planting, sod, and turf
- Paver patios, walkways, driveways, retaining walls, and related hardscape
- Sprinkler diagnosis and repair, irrigation installation, valves, drip systems, and controllers
- Outdoor-living features such as fire pits, pergolas, kitchens, seating walls, and lighting

Pricing and schedules vary with the site, design, material selection, access, preparation, permitting, weather, and project scope. Published pages are informational and do not replace a written proposal.

## Service area

The website identifies service in Covina and communities across the San Gabriel Valley, including West Covina, Glendora, San Dimas, La Verne, Azusa, Claremont, Diamond Bar, Walnut, Pomona, Pasadena, Arcadia, Monrovia, Duarte, El Monte, Baldwin Park, Temple City, Rowland Heights, and Charter Oak. Availability should be confirmed for each address.
